features.depth_rel_ppm: median - min of the presented window flux, times 1e6
features.contrast_ppm: mean(|phase|>3h) - mean(|phase|<=1.8h) of presented flux, times 1e6
features.mad_scatter: median absolute deviation of the presented flux
features.gap_fraction: fraction of cadences whose gap exceeds 0.05 d
features.matched_filter_corr: Pearson correlation with a fixed 150 ppm batman template
features.segment_std_ppm: standard deviation of the presented flux, times 1e6

feature_source: presented window flux (transit injected when label=1); no label or depth argument
split_method: segment-level; unique segments shuffled with RandomState(42), 50/25/25

imputation.rule: median fitted on TRAIN rows only, applied unchanged to val/test
